summary: Implementation covers the main stranded-runtime detection and operator surfaces: shared classifier, workspace runtime/detail event projection, service status, metrics, worker failure/remonitor decisions, and all required validation commands pass. It does not fully achieve the plan because the mutating worker recovery path ignores the retry-policy hook when deciding whether to fail a pre-PR stranded workspace.
gaps: Load Workspace.task_policy into ControlWorker stale runtime candidates and pass retry_policy_allows_recovery into RuntimeWorkspace so pre-PR stranded workspaces with runtime_recovery.stranded_workspace=retry record/defer recovery instead of being marked failed; add a worker regression test for that policy path.
